app.name: Wishlist
app.tagline: A wish list you reveal piece by piece.

aside.headline: Your list stays yours.
aside.body: Add anything you like. Family sees only the items you pick and send.

register.title: Create account
register.checkEmail: We sent a confirmation email to {email}. Open the link to finish signing up.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.body: We'll send a link for setting a new password.
reset.sent: If an account for {email} exists, the link is in the inbox.

update.title: New password
update.expired: This link expired or was already used. Request a new one.

lists.title: Lists
lists.emptyBody: Create your first list — say, "Birthday" or "For the flat".
lists.soon: Lists arrive in the next step.
lists.confirmDelete: Delete the list “{title}” with all its items?

fields.title: Title
fields.eventDateHint: Optional. After it we'll offer to wrap things up.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first — check the inbox.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.weakPassword: Password is too short or too simple.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

item.emptyBody: Paste a product link or type a name. Link and price are both optional.

fields.urlHint: Auto-fill arrives in the next step
fields.title: Title

errors.badUrl: Link must start with http:// or https://
errors.badPrice: Price must be a number of zero or more.
errors.badQuantity: Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 999.

parser.partial: Some fields came back empty — fill the rest in yourself.
parser.gotCurrency: Price found in {currency}. Check it against the list currency.

errors.notSignedIn: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.unreachable: Parser is unreachable. Fill the fields in yourself.
errors.invalidUrl: That doesn't look like a link.
errors.blockedHost: That address is blocked for safety reasons.
errors.unsupported: That link isn't an HTML page.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a minute.
errors.timeout: The shop didn't answer in time.
errors.unknown: Couldn't read that page. Fill the fields in yourself.
errors.authUnavailable: The parser couldn't verify your sign-in. Check its configuration or fill the fields in yourself.
errors.misconfigured: The parser is misconfigured: its Supabase URL is missing.
errors.blockedByShop: This shop blocks automated requests. Copy the name and price in yourself — the link will still be saved.

share.title: My links
share.subtitle: Each one shows only the items you picked. The main list stays private.
share.intro: {n} items will go into this link. The rest of the list stays hidden.
share.ready: Link is ready. Send it to whoever you like.
share.linkHint: Anyone with this link sees the selected items. No sign-up needed.
share.emptyBody: Open a list, hit “Share”, tick the items you want.
share.confirmRevoke: Revoke the link “{title}”? It will stop opening.
share.confirmDelete: Delete the link “{title}” along with its stats?

fields.title: Heading for guests
fields.messageHint: Optional. Everyone who opens the link will see it.
fields.allowReservationsHint: Guests can mark what they're taking. You won't see it — so the surprise holds.
fields.expiresAtHint: Optional. Empty means “until you revoke it”.

errors.nothingSelected: Pick at least one item first.

guest.goneBody: It may have been revoked or expired. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
guest.ownerBanner: This is your own link. Reservations are hidden on purpose — so the gift stays a surprise.
guest.hint: Mark what you're taking and others will see it's spoken for. The list owner can't see this.
guest.emptyBody: Every item from this link is already unavailable.
guest.footer: This list is private. You only see what was shared with you.
